fewShots.question: Can you tell me the total balance for the long-term intercompany receivables of the Kahromaa Company as of January 2024
fewShots.query:
-- Enter SQL query
SELECT SUM(Closing_Balance) AS Total_Balance
FROM [dbo].[trial_balance]
WHERE Entity_Name COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS like '%Kahromaa%'
AND Account_Name COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS LIKE '%Long Term%'
AND Period_Name = 'January 2024';
